decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving equipping Colossus Hammer to a creature for a massive boost in power. The key cards in the deck enable this strategy, such as Puresteel Paladin for free equip costs, Stoneforge Mystic for tutoring equipment, and Urza's Saga for generating tokens to attach equipment. By using efficient creatures and support cards, the deck aims to quickly set up a game-winning attack with a highly powered creature.

This deck focuses on creating a powerful board presence by utilizing Elemental creatures and control spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With cards like Solitude and Fury to remove threats, as well as cards like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation to generate value, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent while also having access to powerful control tools like Teferi, Time Raveler and Prismatic Ending. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and versatility in longer games.

The deck focuses on utilizing Cascade mechanics to rapidly deploy threats onto the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By constantly casting spells with Cascade effects, the deck aims to generate card advantage and tempo, ensuring a consistent stream of threats while controlling the board with counterspells and removal. The combination of creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Brazen Borrower with cascade spells like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent allows for a flexible and dynamic gameplay style, putting pressure on the opponent and closing out games quickly.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on disrupting opponents with hand disruption spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize while pressuring them with efficient threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Tarmogoyf. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Wrenn and Six for additional disruption and card advantage. Mishra's Bauble and Unholy Heat provide additional synergy within the deck, while lands like Urza's Saga help to generate value over time. Overall, this deck aims to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and hand while using powerful creatures and planeswalkers to gain card advantage and pressure the opponent. By utilizing a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and versatile threats, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and grind out a win through incremental advantages. The mana base is carefully constructed to allow for consistent access to all colors while also maximizing the potential of powerful lands like Boseiju, Who Endures. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional value and flexibility in longer games.

The deck focuses on utilizing Cascade cards to cheat out big threats and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By constantly cascading into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to quickly establish board presence and pressure the opponent. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Subtlety and Force of Negation helps protect the deck's threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The land base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and maximize the chances of hitting Cascade triggers.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble a powerful combo utilizing equipment cards such as Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat to quickly defeat the opponent. The deck focuses on efficiently equipping creatures like Ornithopter and Memnite with these powerful equipment to deal massive amounts of damage in a short amount of time. The use of cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin help to search for and equip these key pieces, while protection from cards like Giver of Runes and Shadowspear help to keep your creatures safe. The deck is designed to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and deadly combo.

This UW Control deck focuses on utilizing various counterspells and removal spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It also includes powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria to generate card advantage and maintain control of the game. The deck also has utility lands like Field of Ruin and Spreading Seas to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The companion, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, provides additional value and synergizes well with the deck's creature lineup. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and versatile creatures. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to generate card advantage and disrupt opponents' strategies. Ragavan and Ice-Fang Coatl provide additional threats and card advantage. The mana base is built to support a variety of colors and includes fetch lands for consistency. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a companion that can be blinked for value. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents in a grindy game.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through efficient removal spells and counterspells, while also utilizing powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Ice-Fang Coatl to pressure the opponent. The deck aims to out-value the opponent by gaining card advantage through cards like Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value by blinking permanents for extra triggers. With a diverse mana base and access to a wide range of colors, this deck is flexible and adaptable to various situations.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to keep the opponent's threats in check while generating value with cards like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Wrenn and Six. The deck also utilizes its mana base effectively with cards like Abundant Growth and Spreading Seas to ensure it hits its land drops and fixes its colors. With Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion, the deck can generate even more value by blinking permanents like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Omnath, Locus of Creation.

The deck focuses on assembling the Colossus Hammer combo with Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid to equip a creature with the Hammer for a huge amount of damage in a single turn. It also includes disruptive elements like Esper Sentinel and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the board and protect the combo. The deck aims to quickly set up its pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful, unexpected attack before they have a chance to react. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides additional utility and flexibility in finding key pieces of the combo.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly play low-cost spells to deal damage to the opponent, while also drawing additional cards and generating mana with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Manamorphose. The deck aims to maintain a fast pace with aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while utilizing cards like Light Up the Stage and Reckless Impulse to refill the hand and keep up the pressure. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of burn spells and creature damage in a fast and efficient manner.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly applying pressure to the opponent while maintaining control through counterspells and hand disruption. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Spell Pierce and Archmage's Charm, while also utilizing efficient creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to deal damage quickly. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Unholy Heat help to control the opponent's resources and eliminate threats. Overall, this deck aims to win the game quickly while maintaining control over the opponent's plays.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on utilizing efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell to control the board while aggressing with evasive threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck also runs disruption like Blood Moon and Spell Pierce to disrupt opponents' game plans. The deck's goal is to apply constant pressure on the opponent while disrupting their strategy, ultimately closing out the game quickly with a mix of burn spells and powerful creatures like Murktide Regent.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with a mix of burn spells, counterspells, and efficient threats. The deck aims to use cheap and versatile spells like Lightning Bolt, Unholy Heat, and Counterspell to control the board and protect its creatures, while also utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler to chip away at the opponent's life total. Additionally, the deck can leverage cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to generate card advantage and ensure consistent threats on the battlefield.

The deck focuses on maintaining control of the game by utilizing versatile cards to deal with threats and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also aims to generate value by repeatedly blinking permanents with Yorion, Sky Nomad and leveraging powerful enter-the-battlefield effects. The deck includes a mix of removal, card draw, and creature threats, with a strong focus on mana fixing and consistency. Additionally, it incorporates a small toolbox of creatures to search for with Eladamri's Call and Stoneforge Mystic, providing answers to various situations. Overall, the deck aims to outlast and outvalue the opponent through careful resource management and strategic play.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a variety of spells and abilities, with a key emphasis on countering opponent's spells and manipulating the board state. It also utilizes a wide range of powerful cards and synergies to maintain control and outvalue opponents. By leveraging its versatile card pool and strong mana base, this deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies and gradually gain advantage over time, ultimately leading to a dominant position in the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana and assemble the pieces needed to get Primeval Titan onto the battlefield. By using cards like Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, the deck can generate massive amounts of mana and search for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. Once Primeval Titan is in play, it can search for additional lands or even deal direct damage to the opponent. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board state and quickly close out the game with explosive combos.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and efficiently to get out powerful lands and creatures like Primeval Titan. With cards like Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, the deck can quickly generate large amounts of mana to cast powerful spells and activate abilities. The combo potential of this deck lies in utilizing cards like Urza's Saga and Karn, the Great Creator to search for key pieces like Cavern of Souls and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to overwhelm opponents with powerful board presence and damage.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly by utilizing cards like Azusa, Primeval Titan, and Amulet of Vigor to cheat multiple lands into play each turn. This allows for explosive plays and fast combos to be set up, like searching for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and lands to trigger its ability multiple times for massive damage. The deck also includes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Engineered Explosives to shut down opposing threats and protect its own win conditions. Overall, the deck aims to assemble specific pieces quickly to overwhelm the opponent and win the game efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Azusa, Lost but Seeking, as well as Amulet of Vigor to untap lands. The ultimate goal is to play Primeval Titan to fetch powerful lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Vesuva to create a combo that deals massive amounts of damage to the opponent. The deck also includes utility lands like Bojuka Bog to disrupt graveyard strategies and Urza's Saga for additional artifact support. The strategy revolves around fast mana acceleration and powerful land synergies to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures with various abilities, using Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to tutor for key pieces. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician acts as a central piece to the combo, allowing for card draw and creature sacrifice to fuel the engine. Grist, the Hunger Tide offers another powerful option for generating value and creating a wide board presence. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a toolbox of creatures that work together synergistically to create a powerful combo finish.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures with various abilities to create a combo that generates value and disrupts the opponent's game plan. It includes tutoring cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to search for specific creatures needed for the situation. The key is to use Yawgmoth, Thran Physician's ability to sacrifice creatures and proliferate to control the board and drain the opponent's life with Zulaport Cutthroat. The deck also generates mana efficiently with cards like Birds of Paradise and Ignoble Hierarch to support its combo plan.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize the powerful card Glimpse of Tomorrow to quickly cheat huge threats into play. By cascading into Glimpse of Tomorrow with cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, you can potentially exile all your top decked permanents and replace them with powerful creatures like Primeval Titan and Chancellor of the Forge. The use of Wavesifter, Tireless Provisioner, and Goblin Dark-Dwellers helps ramp up mana and provide additional value to overwhelm your opponent with big creatures and overwhelming board presence.

This deck focuses on assembling a quick and explosive combo using Colossus Hammer in combination with Puresteel Paladin, Stoneforge Mystic, and Sigarda's Aid. By equipping Colossus Hammer for virtually no cost, creatures like Memnite and Ornithopter become lethal threats capable of dealing massive damage in just one swing. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Teferi, Time Raveler and Esper Sentinel to protect the combo and disrupt opposing strategies. The mana base is designed to support the combo with efficient land choices and Urza's Saga for additional value.

The deck revolves around maximizing the power and toughness of artifact creatures through the use of counters and synergies with Hardened Scales. This allows for explosive and aggressive plays, overwhelming the opponent with threats that quickly grow out of control. The deck also includes utility lands and artifacts to provide additional support and resilience in the face of removal spells or board wipes. Overall, the strategy is to build up a strong board presence quickly and efficiently, applying relentless pressure to force the opponent into a defensive position.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will, then cast Living End to bring all those creatures back onto the battlefield for a massive board presence. The deck also includes disrupt cards like Grief and Force of Negation to control the game and protect your combo. Colossal Skyturtle and Striped Riverwinder provide alternate win conditions if the Living End plan doesn't work out. The deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with a combination of speed and powerful creatures.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly playing efficient threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Murktide Regent, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Archmage's Charm and Counterspell. Mishra's Bauble and Consider help dig for more threats and answers, while Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide removal and reach. The deck's mana base is streamlined to support its spells and maximize early plays, allowing it to apply pressure and control the board in order to win the game quickly.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, alongside powerful spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats. The deck also utilizes card advantage through Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration, while maintaining control with counterspells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell. The main focus is to apply early pressure, disrupt opponent's strategy, and close out the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a combination of red and green cards to disrupt the opponent's strategy. By playing powerful control cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Utopia Sprawl, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Bonecrusher Giant, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot. Blood Moon is used to shut down non-basic lands, while Wrenn and Six provide card advantage. The deck also includes threats like Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Klothys, God of Destiny to apply pressure and close out the game.

This deck focuses on creating a lockout board state by ramping up mana with Utopia Sprawl and Arbor Elf to cast powerful control spells like Blood Moon and Karn, the Great Creator. It also aims to disrupt opponents with cards like Dead / Gone and Endurance while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Bonecrusher Giant. The deck combines efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and versatile threats like Seasoned Pyromancer to maintain board control and overwhelm opponents. The goal is to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents to secure victory in a longer game.
